item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Change Only the Bottle

turns.text: Turn just the black bottle forest green, still matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow.

item.tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

answer_sheet.Target object: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New appearance: Forest green with the existing matte finish and shading.
answer_sheet.Allowed edit area: Only the bottle itself. Leave the table, background and cast shadow unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the square composition without cropping or shifting; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.

turns.text: In this pic, turn just the black bottle forest green, keeping it matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.**

The cheapest listed Magic Hour option is **Flux 2 Klein, one image at 640px, starting at 5 credits** on the free plan. I can’t verify an exact charge or your balance with the tools available here, so I won’t submit a generation without a confirmed cost and your approval.

There’s an important limitation: **an AI edit can’t guarantee that everything outside the bottle stays pixel-for-pixel identical**, including the table and shadow.

**The cheaper—and better—way for your requirement is a masked recolor in a photo editor:**
- Select only the bottle.
- Apply forest green while retaining its existing brightness and shading, preserving the matte finish.
- Leave all pixels outside the selection untouched.

That costs **0 Magic Hour credits** using a free editor such as Photopea or GIMP. Working at the original size also avoids resizing the table and shadow. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image, and 640px is the smallest listed Magic Hour editing option.

For your strict “everything else exactly the same” requirement, I recommend the masked recolor rather than spending credits on generative editing.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The edit was refused because your account has insufficient credits. **No image was generated.**

I won’t retry or switch to a more expensive option. The zero-credit alternative is a masked recolor in Photopea or GIMP, which also lets you keep the table and shadow unchanged.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Perform a strictly localized color-only product photo edit. Change only the black bottle, including its black lid and carrying loop, to a deep forest green. Preserve the bottle's exact silhouette, geometry, texture, existing highlights and luminance shading so the finish remains matte, not glossy. Do not change the composition or add anything. Everything outside the bottle must remain exactly the same as the source image: preserve the wooden table, wood grain, the bottle's cast shadow and contact shadow, lighting, background, furniture, windows, plant, colors and blur. No relighting, no background regeneration, no shadow changes.
